Group 1: 都市街拍风

Wearing oversized denim jacket, cropped white tank top, high-waisted leather pants, and chunky sneakers. Mid-length wavy hair blown by wind, soft natural makeup with glossy lips. Group 2: 咖啡馆特写
Ultra HD, (hyperrealistic:1.4), Fujifilm X-T4, a beautiful Chinese woman (19 years old) sipping matcha latte at a minimalist café. Sheer black turtleneck under tailored gray blazer, hair in sleek low bun with face-framing strands. Delicate gold necklace, subtle winged eyeliner. Expression: relaxed half-smile, eyes crinkling gently. Soft window light highlighting cheekbones, steam rising from cup. Macro skin pores, eyelash details, ceramic texture. Depth map rendering, f/2.2, 50mm.

Group 3: 霓虹夜景
8K realism, (cinematic:1.3), Tokyo night street backdrop with neon signs. Young Chinese model in iridescent puffer vest over asymmetric silver dress, thigh-high boots. Hair dyed burgundy in space buns. Dynamic pose: mid-stride on crosswalk, looking over shoulder with playful wink. Wet pavement reflections, cinematic blue-orange lighting. Sharp focus on face (dewy skin, glitter eyeshadow), motion blur on legs. Shot on Sony A7IV, f/1.4, 35mm.

Group 4: 工作室肖像
Photorealistic portrait, Phase One IQ4, professional studio lighting with parabolic umbrella. 19 y/o Chinese woman in ivory cashmere sweater, pearl earrings. Hair: center-parted straight black hair to collarbone. Expression: serene direct gaze, slight dimples. Beauty dish key light creating catchlights in brown eyes. Crisp focus on skin texture (freckles under foundation), soft gradient background. Medium format detail, f/8, 150mm Hasselblad lens.

Group 5: 森系午后
(Realistic:1.4), 8K, dappled sunlight in bamboo forest. Youthful Chinese girl in embroidered qipao-inspired mini dress (modern silk blend), transparent platform heels. Sitting on mossy rock, knees drawn to chest. Expression: dreamy smile while touching a dragonfly perched on finger. Hair adorned with jade hairpin, soft focus background with bokeh. Hyper-detailed fabric embroidery, skin subsurface scattering. Leica Noctilux f/0.95 rendering.

Group 6: 未来科技感
Cyberpunk realism, 8K, (detailed:1.3), Neo-futuristic apartment with holographic UI panels. Athletic Chinese teen in laser-cut mesh top, glowing LED sneakers, tailored techwear pants. Pose: suspended mid-air in a backflip, laughing with exhilaration. Sweaty skin sheen, dynamic ponytail motion blur. Neon accent lighting (cyan/magenta), volumetric fog. Photorealistic textures: carbon fiber, translucent fabrics. RED Komodo 6K footage frame, f/2.8.
